title: Special repairs and Civil Maintenance to Lighthouse Tower, Technical Buildings Museum and allied buildings, arial mast towers and Compound wall etc., at Muttom Point Lighthouse station.
summary: E-tender for special repairs and civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower, technical buildings, museum, allied buildings, aerial mast towers and compound wall at Muttom Point Lighthouse, Kanyakumari district, with a technical corrigendum converting it to a percentage-rate contract.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Muttom Point Lighthouse station, Muttom Point, Kanyakumari District, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Special repairs and civil maintenance to tower, technical buildings, museum, allied buildings, aerial mast towers and compound wall

scope.item: Special repairs and Civil Maintenance to Lighthouse Tower, Technical Buildings, Museum and allied buildings, aerial mast towers and Compound wall etc. (no BOQ in these documents)

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening; original EMD by 24.07.2024 15:00.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; only fully completed works; values updated at 7% per annum; certificates from officers below Executive Engineer not considered
Similar works = repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
Key technical personnel for supervision; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); affidavit of not blacklisted
List of relatives serving in MoPSW or DGLL; Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)

corrigenda.change: Item rate in schedule of work to be read as percentage rate (percentage above/below total estimated cost in figures and words; tie-break by revised sealed offers then draw of lots; 50% EMD forfeiture for refusing revised offer); Special Condition of Contract item 40 revised for excess quantities beyond +/-15% and extra/substituted items

notes: NIT dated 11/07/2024 but bid download/submission period starts 30.05.2024 15:00 (to 24.07.2024 15:00), so this appears to be a re-issued notice (Tender ID suffix _2); published date taken as 30.05.2024 start of download period. Note 1.1 refers to tender fee DD although tender fee is NIL.
